title: Identifying Signal-Crosstalk Mechanism in Maize Plants during Combined Salinity and Boron Stress Using Integrative Systems Biology Approaches.
authors: Barua, Drishtee; Mishra, Asutosh; Kirti, P B; Barah, Pankaj
one_liner_zh: 该文通过整合转录组和蛋白互作网络分析玉米盐与硼复合胁迫下的信号串扰，虽涉及转录因子识别，但缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模及AI/物理模拟方法，仅用机器学习辅助网络分析，与本课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: Combined stress has been seen as a major threat to world agriculture production. Maize is one of the leading cereal crops of the world due to its wide spectrum of growth conditions and is moderately sensitive to salt stress. A saline soil environment is a major factor that hinders its growth and overall yield and causes an increase in the concentration of micronutrients like boron, leading to excess over the requirement of the plant. Boron toxicity combined with salinity has been reported to be a serious threat to the yield and quality of maize. The response signatures of the maize plants to the combined effect of salinity and boron stress have not been studied well. We carried out an integrative systems-level analysis of the publicly available transcriptomic data generated on tolerant maize (Lluteno maize from the Atacama Desert, Chile) landrace under combined salt and boron stress. We identified significant biological processes that are differentially regulated in combined salt and boron stress in the leaves and roots of maize, respectively. Protein-protein interaction network analysis identified important roles of aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH), galactinol synthase 2 (GOLS2) proteins of leaf and proteolipid membrane potential regulator (pmpm4), metallothionein lea protein group 3 (mlg3), and cold regulated 410 (COR410) proteins of root in salt tolerance and regulating boron toxicity in maize. Identification of transcription factors coupled with regulatory network analysis using machine learning approach identified a few heat shock factors (HSFs) and NAC (NAM (no apical meristem, Petunia), ATAF1-2 (Arabidopsis thaliana activating factor), and CUC2 (cup-shaped cotyledon, Arabidopsis)) family transcription factors (TFs) to play crucial roles in salt tolerance, maintaining reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels and minimizing oxidative damage to the cells. These findings will provide new ways to design targeted functional validation experiments for developing multistress-resistant maize crops.
abstract_zh: 复合胁迫已被视为世界农业生产的主要威胁。玉米因其广泛的生长适应性而成为全球主要谷类作物之一，但对盐胁迫中度敏感。盐渍土壤环境是阻碍其生长和总体产量的主要因素，并导致硼等微量营养素浓度升高，超出植物需求。据报道，硼毒性与盐分联合作用对玉米的产量和品质构成严重威胁。玉米植株对盐分和硼胁迫联合效应的响应特征尚未得到充分研究。我们对公开可用的转录组数据进行了整合性系统水平分析，这些数据来源于耐性玉米（智利阿塔卡马沙漠的Lluteno玉米地方品种）在盐分和硼联合胁迫下的表达谱。我们鉴定了玉米叶片和根中在盐分和硼联合胁迫下差异调控的重要生物学过程。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析揭示了叶片中的醛脱氢酶（ALDH）、半乳糖醇合酶2（GOLS2）蛋白以及根中的蛋白脂质膜电位调节因子（pmpm4）、金属硫蛋白LEA蛋白组3（mlg3）和冷调节蛋白410（COR410）在玉米耐盐性和调控硼毒性中的重要作用。结合机器学习方法的调控网络分析鉴定出少数热激因子（HSFs）和NAC（NAM（无顶端分生组织，矮牵牛）、ATAF1-2（拟南芥激活因子）和CUC2（杯状子叶，拟南芥））家族转录因子（TFs），它们在耐盐性、维持活性氧（ROS）水平及最小化细胞氧化损伤中发挥关键作用。这些发现将为设计靶向功能验证实验以开发多胁迫抗性玉米作物提供新途径。
